Since the tension side of the plate near the surface is the CR, only the microstructure near the edge (surface) as shown Fig. 1(a) is of interest and will be mapped into the micro-model. In the current work, the Al+Si eutectic (EU) will be considered as one single entity (phase), together with the primary Al-dendrites (and pores). A Matlab code is used to digitize the image as shown in Fig. 1(a) into Abaqus elements sets of Al, eutectic and pores and used as an input in the Abaqus input file to construct the micro-model. Fig. 14 is the Abaqus model representation of part of the microstructure of Fig. 1(a) with a square of 300×300 2D plane strain meshes. The volume fraction of the eutectic (f ) is about 0.32 (and eu that of the pores is about 0.5%).
